Everything you need to ship from India to Costa Rica or import from Costa Rica to India: the trade agreement, routes and transit times, how your buyer imports, duties, regulators and documents.
India and Costa Rica at a glance
India exports pharmaceuticals, vehicles and motorcycles, chemicals, textiles and steel. India buys medical devices and electronic components from Costa Rica's free zones.
Routes and transit times to Costa Rica
35–50 days to Moín, via Cartagena or Panama transhipment.
Transit times are indicative port-to-port from Nhava Sheva / Mundra (sea) and Delhi / Mumbai (air). Routing changes (for example Red Sea diversions) can add 10–14 days.
EXPORTING FROM INDIA TO COSTA RICA
Importing into Costa Rica: what your buyer needs
Declarations are filed on TICA through a licensed customs agent (agente aduanero).
Strong free-zone sector: many importers operate under free-zone regimes.
Central American common tariff (DAI), plus 13% VAT (IVA) and selective consumption tax on some goods.
Ministry of Health: medicines, food, cosmetics registration
SFE / SENASA: plant and animal health

From Costa Rica to India, and tips from the field
Importing from Costa Rica into India
Medical devices and electronics from free zones.
File the Bill of Entry through a licensed customs broker in India (YAM holds licence R-7/92).
Check the HS code in the Indian tariff, the DGFT import policy (free, restricted or prohibited) and any BIS, FSSAI, plant quarantine or other permit before the goods ship.
If an agreement applies, get the correct certificate of origin from the exporter to claim the lower duty.
Product registration with the Ministry of Health can take months: start early.
